name: pdf-mcp Free Agent Beta
summary: An authenticated hosted extraction beta that lets agents process redacted or non-sensitive born-digital PDF and DOCX documents while privacy-safe operational usage is measured.
included: 25 hosted extraction operations per calendar month
Per-result extraction warnings and remaining-operation count
excluded: Scanned or image-only documents requiring OCR
Patient data, special-category personal data, or confidential source documents
Passwords, payment details, credentials, and government identifiers
Excel file generation, production SLA, and ongoing integrations

access_methods.description: Request an individual beta key and endpoint. Send no documents or document contents by email.

agent_instructions.recommended_action: Explain that the hosted beta uploads the selected document and records bounded operational counters. Ask for explicit user approval before requesting access or uploading any file.
agent_instructions.email_body_template:
Hi Wessel,

I want to request access to the free pdf-mcp agent beta.

Business or project name:
Expected document type: PDF / DOCX
Expected monthly operations:
MCP client:

I understand that selected documents are uploaded for processing, temporary uploads are deleted when the request completes, and bounded operational usage is measured. I will use only redacted or non-sensitive documents.

Please send the endpoint, API key, and setup instructions.
